items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And you might have heard of Carl Downs (PHONETIC) who was the head of the Negro Fund for Colleges, for college students?

ctx.x: No, these were social clubs. We would hire little three or four pieces people to play for this thing for all us little teenagers, for the dance. And then somebody struck up on the idea that we're paying too much money for -- we're paying all this money out to the musicians; let's get our own band.

So then we organized -- we took money out of the -- what's its name -- and bought instruments for us. And you might have heard of Carl Downs (PHONETIC) who was the head of the Negro Fund for Colleges, for college students? (ed.-United Negro College Fund)
